name: agent_run
description: Launch a configured ctxloom agent as a delegated child session. Async spawn: returns at enqueue with the child's ids (child_agent_id is its harp — its address and continuation token); results, questions, and reports come back as mailbox messages (agent_recv). Follow-ups go down with agent_send. Children execute serially (a spawn past the cap queues) and never prompt: the agent must declare a headless-safe permission enum.

constraints.description: Optional model/tools/sandbox hints (unused today; the agent's own binding decides)

input.description: Child task input. `prompt` carries the child's briefing, delivered as its first turn. Optional `workspace` ("none"|"worktree"): "none" runs the child in the parent's live project checkout (it can stomp the parent's files, and sees the parent's uncommitted edits); "worktree" carves the child its own git worktree, checked out at HEAD (it will NOT see the parent's uncommitted edits). Empty defers to the project config if it sets one explicitly, otherwise defaults to worktree. This isolates the child's WORKING FILES only — it does not isolate the engine's own global config/credentials/session store from the parent's

examples.prompt: Review the diff on branch X for correctness bugs

role.description: Configured ctxloom agent name to launch (its composed profiles, engine binding, runtime axis, and permission enum are honored; see `ctxloom agent list`)
